confirmed: Read all 252 markdown lines and all eight PDF pages. The PDF is arXiv:2502.17962v3, 13 May 2025, titled The Dynamics of Collective Creativity in Human-AI Hybrid Societies, with Shiiku, Marjieh, Anglada-Tort and Jacoby as authors; the recorded source.version is correct (PDF p. 1).

Random assignment is stated only for node location, with each person contributing once. Assignment between human-only and hybrid network composition is not specified; retain other/not_stated for the hybrid assistance contrast and core eligibility unclear. has_randomized_people_study=false means no qualifying random assignment was established from this version, not proof that allocation was non-random (PDF p. 3, Network Experiments on Collective Creativity).

The reported storytelling sample is 879 people recruited on Prolific from the UK who identified English as their native language; human condition Ns are 625 and 254. The 996 GPT-4o calls overall and 625 AI-only API calls are not people; the stated GPT-4o release date is September 3, 2024 (PDF p. 3, Method; condition Ns also in Figure 1B, p. 2).

The hybrid condition is described as 50% human and 50% GPT-4o, with origin of stories undisclosed. Its reported outcome summaries combine human and AI stories, rather than identifying a separate human-authored estimate (PDF pp. 3-4, condition definitions, Measures of Creativity and Results).

Validation uses randomized selections of stories, each rater evaluating 20 stories on a scale from 1 to 5. This is outcome measurement, not random assignment of creative-task participants to AI assistance; raters must not be added to the storytelling sample (PDF p. 4, Measures of Creativity).

Creativity levels match the PDF: Human-AI M = 2.327, SD = 1.159, 95% CI [2.184, 2.576]; Human-only M = 2.482, SD = 1.026, 95% CI [2.389, 2.576]. The source calls them similar but prints p < .001, as the form notes (PDF p. 4, Results: Creativity and Diversity, first paragraph across columns).

Diversity levels match the PDF: Human-AI M = 0.860, SD = 0.043, 95% CI [0.806, 0.913]; Human-only M = 0.823, SD = 0.019, 95% CI [0.800, 0.900]. No numerical test of that between-condition difference is given (PDF p. 4, Results: Creativity and Diversity, paragraph beginning Next).

Diversity change is Human-AI M = 0.098, SD = 0.039, 95% CI [0.064, 0.131], versus AI-only M = −0.034, SD = 0.17, 95% CI [-0.047, -0.021]. These are within-condition changes, with hybrid diversity highest in the final iterations (PDF p. 4, paragraph beginning However and Figure 2D).
The pure AI benchmark reports creativity M = 3.571, SD = 1.026, 95% CI [3.491, 3.652], and diversity M = 0.880, SD = 0.017, 95% CI [0.859, 0.900] (PDF p. 4, Results: Creativity and Diversity).

This is an original network experiment with a separate validation sample, not a synthesis; the 106-study meta-analysis mentioned in the introduction is a cited prior paper. No appendix follows the references, and no supplement is identified in this PDF (PDF pp. 1, 3-4 and 7-8).
summary: The May 2025 arXiv v3 does not establish random assignment to AI assistance, but it includes an AI-versus-human output benchmark. Corrections address unconfirmed analyzed counts, conflicting rater counts (100 in text versus 94 in Figure 1C), corrupted symbols, and omitted creativity-change and diversity-method details.
